newsitem.title: USA: US East Coast distillate stocks down 1.6 mln bbl.
newsitem.headline: US East Coast distillate stocks down 1.6 mln bbl.

text.p: Distillate stocks in the key U.S. East Coast region stood at 44.0 million barrels for the week ended January 24, down 1.6 million barrels from the previous week and down 900,000 barrels from a year ago, the Energy Information Administration said Wednesday.

"Once again, distillate stocks are below normal because of the situation in PADD I (East Coast) where the seasonally adjusted three-year (1993-1995) average band width currently ranges from a high of 61.5 million barrels to a low of 49.4 million barrels," EIA said in its weekly distillate watch.

Total U.S. distillate inventories, which include heating oil and diesel, at 118.5 million barrels at the end of last week were 1.0 million barrels higher than a year ago, although they were off 2.5 million barrels from the previous week.

EIA reported total U.S. distillate production at 3.03 million barrels per day for the week ended January 24, off about 50,000 bpd from the previous week, with lower output from East Coast, Midwest and Gulf Coast refineries, and increases west of the Rocky Mountains.
